request.body: the canvas content JSON value, stored verbatim

verified_readback: exact CanvasAudit row by returned audit_id and canvas_id
audit content digest equals the frozen request content
audit operation_id equals the frozen operation when supplied
Canvas mirror content equals the audit content
audit and canvas tenant match the frozen actor tenant
audit actor matches the frozen actor
canvas workspace matches the frozen workspace
duplicate already_applied result is the latest audit row

http_refusal_mapping.404: canvas not found or not owned by the actor

verified_readback: exact new CanvasAudit row by returned audit_id and canvas_id
restored content equals the canonical target content
Canvas mirror content equals the restored content
audit and canvas tenant match the frozen actor tenant
audit actor matches the frozen actor
canvas workspace matches the frozen workspace
no-change restore target content equals the current latest content

http_refusal_mapping.404: canvas or target audit not found or not owned by the actor
http_refusal_mapping.400: other before-write refusal (for example a deletion marker)

covered_controls: direct PUT positive twin with fresh-session audit/mirror readback
direct restore positive twin with append-only provenance
exact content despite equal title and length
duplicate operation idempotency without a second audit
byte-identical deliberate edit without an operation id
duplicate operation after a later edit is unverified and does not revert the later content
no-change restore with no audit appended
foreign user/canvas and foreign audit refusal
workspace and tenant mismatch after commit
oracle None, exception, refuted and kill-switch outcomes
no-change under the kill switch is unverified with no audit
verifier-level operation, absent-audit, stale-mirror and restore-target mismatches
no request DB session passed to the verifier
not_covered: other canvas routes (context/state, logic, WebSocket state updates, submit, fork, delete)
